source.purpose: P12 draft candidate harvested from the remaining official HarmonyOS-Examples reserve after the regular Phase06 checkpoint reached 50/50 live passed.

entries.usage_goal: Add a lightweight calendar route page that keeps stacked button composition and Router.push handoff inside one render-facing page shell.
blocking_constraints: Keep the three Router.push targets and stacked button layout source-backed inside the page shell; do not invent route coordinators or detached menu helpers.

source.purpose: P12 draft candidate drawn from the remaining official HarmonyOS-Examples reserve to extend Router-param web content coverage without hidden local helpers.

entries.usage_goal: Add a parameter-driven web content page that keeps Router param hydration, back navigation, and embedded Web rendering inside one render-facing page shell.
blocking_constraints: Keep Router.getParamsObject title/src hydration, back-button routing, resource-backed icons, and Web(src) source-backed inside the page boundary; do not fabricate separate navigation view models.

source.purpose: P12 draft candidate selected from the remaining official HarmonyOS-Examples reserve to extend page-plus-rich-component coverage with an explicit helper freeze instead of hidden same-package dependence.

entries.usage_goal: Add a charging-status host sample that keeps page-owned power and charging state in the page shell while freezing the animated ElectricQuantity component explicitly as a companion slice.
blocking_constraints: Keep power/isCharging state plus Slider and Toggle wiring in the page host, and keep the bubble animation, canvas drawing, and charging gradient logic source-backed in ElectricQuantity; do not collapse the helper into a synthetic single-file abstraction.
